description: The study applies HEC-RAS 2D to four potential Attabad landslide-dam breach scenarios along 121 kilometres of the Hunza River in Pakistan. It evaluates flood depth, velocity and arrival times at bridges. The metadata is published or maintained by Muhammad Rashid; Sajjad Haider; Muhammad Waqar Saleem and coauthors (provider deposit/publication). Coverage is at regional scale in Pakistan. Any further spatial resolution, complete time span or sampling interval beyond the details above is not verified here. The application is documented through a public publication or case-study page; availability of its underlying model inputs is not established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The inspected public record or source repository is free to read; this does not grant rights beyond its stated licence. Caveats: Independent reuse and ongoing maintenance were not established; admission depends on the open single-study rule.
